releaseNotes:
Version 1.1 — UI and Report Improvements

What is new in this version:
- Modern M3 SearchBar for searching cases
- FilterChip for category filtering
- ModalBottomSheet for adding photos
- Improved PDF report with higher quality photos
- Better text contrast in PDF reports
- Overall UI polish and stability improvements
